emptyBody: Create an assistant and connect a language model in the web app, then chat with it here.

emptyBodyCreate: Create an assistant: give it instructions, pick a model, and start chatting with your finances.
archivedNotice: This assistant is archived. Unarchive it from Edit to list it again.

form.name: Name
form.systemPromptPlaceholder: You are a helpful financial assistant. Always cite sources...
form.connectionRequired: Pick a connection — assistants need one to talk to an LLM.
form.needConnectionHint: An assistant needs a connection (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, …) to talk to a model. Set one up, then come back here.
form.autoContextHint: Prepend a small primer with your name, currency, today's date, and account list at the start of every conversation. Saves the assistant from having to ask. Turn off for pure knowledge-base assistants.
form.isDefaultHint: Opens first when you start chatting. Only one assistant can be the default; turning this on clears it on the others.
form.deleteConfirm: Delete this assistant? Its conversations and uploaded knowledge are removed too.

connections.title: LLM Connections
connections.subtitle: Add the LLM providers you want to use — local Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Pick one per assistant.
connections.name: Name
connections.baseUrlRequired: Endpoint URL is required for this provider
connections.ollamaHint: If Ollama runs on your host machine, use http://host.docker.internal:11434 (Mac/Windows) or your host IP (Linux).
connections.openaiCompatHint: Just paste the host:port (e.g. http://192.168.1.142:1234). The /v1 path is added automatically. From inside Docker on Mac/Windows, replace localhost with host.docker.internal.
connections.apiKeyPlaceholder: sk-... or leave blank for local providers
connections.apiKeyPlaceholderEdit: Leave blank to keep the existing key
connections.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted using your instance secret. Never returned by the API.
connections.setAsDefault: Use as default for new assistants
connections.deleteConfirm: Delete connection "{{name}}"? Assistants pointing at it will fall back to the instance default.
connections.emptyBody: Add a connection to point Securo at your local Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
